packageRules.description: One grouped pull request a week for development dependencies.

Development dependency patches are grouped weekly and never automerged: each merge is invoked on a green head, as ADR 0046 requires. Automerge was on here and contradicted that rule; a build tool can change shipped output.
Never automerge a runtime dependency, a major bump or a GitHub Action.
Actions are pinned to a commit hash on purpose. Renovate keeps the hash current and the comment beside it accurate; its merge is invoked like any other, never automerged.
TypeScript and Node move on the quarterly cadence plan section 4 sets, not whenever a release lands.
